challenge.method: Check whether all three labels apply to Python itself and whether the list is exhaustive.
challenge.results: All three apply. The FAQ presents examples, leaving room for additional styles and making no purity claim.

limitations: The labels are the FAQ's characterization. The claim assigns no paradigm exclusivity or purity.
